notes: Standard prophetic word-event formula; the waw takes *Moreover* rather than *And* because that is the connective the ASV wrote (rule 14's open list).
הָיָה is not presentative here: the ASV writes an ordinary *came*, so no rule 21 frame and no rule 45 *that* is present to place.
The construct דְבַר governs a proper name carrying no article morpheme, so the single written *the* is the supplied one on the construct (rule 29).
